messages:
casey: Heads-up: partners want a clear orchestration plan for H100/H200/MI300/Gaudi so marketplace GA, SI demos, and joint press don't collide. Need a compact decision matrix and waiver flow by EOD.

mira: I'll own marketplace slotting. Will publish per-region hard caps and suggested GA windows. Target: EOD today.

dylan: SI ask: partners request up to 2 exclusive demo-days each. Recommend we book these via the internal demo-isle calendar and limit exclusives to non-overlap with press windows.

harper: Comms: propose APAC quiet window 72h, EU 48h, US 24h. Also want a one-click waiver template for exceptions with exec approval step.

ops-bot: New doc: https://redwood.company/docs/partners/stackflow-orch-v1 - reviewers: mira, harper.

casey: Draft tiny matrix please (region | primary | fallback | embargo-risk). Keep any hardware-specific notes separate.

mira: Quick draft below (very rough):
```
region,primary,fallback,embargo-risk
us-east,h100,h200,medium
eu-central,mi300,h200,low
apac-north,h100,mi300,high
sa-east,gaudi,mi300,medium
```

mira: Notes: APAC thermal derates mean H100 queues can add ~36-72h drift. B200 recommended only for background batch jobs (not demos).

dylan: Ops asks: need fallback image tags and auto-route triggers. Requesting tags: `redwood/fallback:mi300-quant` and `redwood/fallback:h200-slim`. Canary policy: failover if p95 latency > 350ms for 5m.

harper: I'll add embargo waiver email template to the doc. Waivers require product + comms + partner lead ack for APAC. Exec sign-off needed if waiver reduces quiet window beneath hard thresholds.

casey: Any firmware/driver risks we should call out? If yes, create a watch task and assign hw-ops.

mira: Found one: gaudi driver v2.1 pending vendor sign-off for eu-central, target sign-off date next Tue. Marked as "firmware-risk" with impact: 3-5d regional outage if delayed.

ops-bot: Task created: /tasks/42319 - "gaudi eu-central driver sign-off watch" assigned to hw-ops. Due: next-wed.

dylan: Engineering can prototype the routing policy this week; will validate runtime fallback and per-tenant overrides by Fri.
harper: Action items recap (I'll paste into PR):
- Mira: marketplace caps per region + final matrix (EOD)
- Dylan: validate fallback images + canary routing (Fri)
- Harper: embargo playbook + waiver template (EOD)
- Casey: collect SI exclusives and publish demo-isle booking constraints (tomorrow)

casey: One more policy question: hard block vs advisory for cross-vendor posts in APAC? I propose a hard block for simultaneous public posts within 48h in APAC; advisory elsewhere.
harper: Agree to hard block in APAC. I'll encode policy in the playbook.
mira: Uploading preliminary quota sheet to doc now.

casey: Thanks team. If anything drifts >48h escalate immediately and we'll pull execs into a readout.
